topics.title_zh: FCC 批准 SpaceX 部署百万颗 Starmind 算力卫星
topics.title_en: FCC Greenlights SpaceX to Deploy 1 Million Starmind Compute Satellites
topics.summary_zh: FCC正式批准SpaceX部署百万颗Starmind轨道卫星构建全球AI算力集群，德州环境质量委员会随后紧随其后开放SpaceX天然气电站审批。此举意在绕过地面电力与土地资源瓶颈，构建太空边缘算力，引发了关于全球算力主权与基础设施失控的激烈讨论。
topics.summary_en: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy 1 million Starmind satellites for orbital AI clusters, bolstered by Texas approving SpaceX’s gas power plants. This initiative aims to bypass terrestrial energy constraints and land bottlenecks, sparking intense debate over global compute sovereignty and the potential for runaway infrastructure expansion.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 地面电网已不堪重负，轨道算力是解决能源与散热瓶颈、实现AI基础设施全球覆盖的唯一跨维度出路。
perspective_pro.point_en: Terrestrial power grids are at a breaking point. Orbital compute is the only multi-dimensional path to solving energy and cooling bottlenecks while achieving global AI reach.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 航空航天与太空法学者
perspective_con.point_zh: 百万量级卫星部署将带来灾难性的轨道碎片风险，且太空算力的发射与维护成本远超商业可行性，纯属资本狂想。
perspective_con.point_en: Deploying a million satellites introduces catastrophic orbital debris risks, while the launch and maintenance costs of space-based compute lack commercial viability; it's pure capital fantasy.

linked_tweets.author: @tribunephl
linked_tweets.content_zh:
SPACEX 获得在太空部署 100 万颗人工智能卫星的批准！

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 已获得美国联邦通信委员会 (#FCC) 的授权，可部署多达 100 万颗卫星，用作轨道上的人工智能数据中心。

这个名为“Starmind”的雄心勃勃的项目于 2026 年 11 月 25 日星期三获得批准，旨在利用太阳能计算卫星为地球上的人工智能应用处理大量数据。

然而，科学家们对该项目的可行性提出了担忧，包括在太空中冷却计算机的困难、潜在的轨道碰撞、空间碎片以及可能扰乱天文观测的光污染增加。

尽管 FCC 已授予授权，#SpaceX 直到 2033 年才需要部署第一颗卫星，进一步的部署里程碑将延长到 2040 年。

#每日论坛报
linked_tweets.content_en:
SPACEX GETS APPROVAL FOR 1 MILLION AI SATELLITES IN SPACE!

Elon Musk's SpaceX has received authorization from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (#FCC) to deploy up to one million satellites designed to serve as artificial intelligence data centers in orbit.

Approved on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the ambitious project, called "Starmind," aims to use solar-powered computing satellites to process massive amounts of data for AI applications on Earth.

However, scientists have raised concerns over the project's feasibility, including the difficulty of cooling computers in space, potential orbital collisions, space debris and increased light pollution that could disrupt astronomical observations.

Although the FCC has granted authorization, #SpaceX is not required to deploy its first satellite until 2033, with further deployment milestones extending through 2040.

#dailytribune

topics.title_zh: 英伟达对东南亚断供与ASML抵制美国管制
topics.title_en: Nvidia Halts SE Asia Shipments as ASML Fights US Curbs
topics.summary_zh: 为响应美国新规，英伟达暂停向东南亚四国提供高性能服务器，旨在截断算力通过云端的违规流转。与此同时，荷兰ASML CEO公开警示称，过度激进的对华出口管制只会迫使中国加倍自主研发，最终导致西方半导体技术制衡能力的彻底崩塌。
topics.summary_en: Responding to US regulations, Nvidia halted high-end server shipments to four SE Asian nations to plug cloud-based loopholes. Concurrently, ASML's CEO warned that aggressive export curbs will only force China to accelerate domestic R&D, ultimately eroding the West's long-term semiconductor leverage.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 美国商务部出口管制官员
perspective_pro.point_zh: 算力即战略资源，必须采取全方位围堵策略，防止任何转口贸易渠道成为绕过制裁的避风港。
perspective_pro.point_en: Compute is a strategic asset. A comprehensive containment strategy is necessary to ensure no re-export channels become loopholes for bypassing sanctions.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 欧洲半导体设备商高管
perspective_con.point_zh: 行政干预正在重塑全球供应链结构，这种短期行政强制行为只会让欧洲顶级半导体企业失去最重要的市场，并加速中国的技术独立。
perspective_con.point_en: Administrative intervention is distorting global supply chains. These short-term forced actions will isolate top European firms from their biggest market and accelerate Chinese technical independence.

linked_tweets.author: @xiaopenghexpeng
linked_tweets.content_zh:
很荣幸分享我对人形机器人未来的想法
在《经济学人》的“2027 年未来世界”中。 @经济学人

我相信2027年将标志着先进通用人形机器人大规模生产的开始。物理AI时代越来越近了。

然而，业界低估了物理AI硬件的难度。建造先进的人类机器人比设计智能车辆复杂大约 20 倍。

机器人必须以软件思维来设计，但硬件必须放在第一位。机器人还需要多种思维速度，它们学习的数据需要多样性，而不仅仅是数量。
https://www.economist.com/the-world-ahead/2026/1/get-ready-for- humanoid-robots-says-he-xiaopeng
linked_tweets.content_en:
Honored to share my thoughts on the future of humanoid robot
in The Economist's "The World Ahead 2027". @TheEconomist 

I believe that 2027 will mark the beginning of mass production for advanced general-purpose humanoid robots. The physical Al era is getting closer.

However, the industry has underestimated the difficulty of Physical AI hardware. Building an advanced human robot is roughly 20 times more complex than engineering a smart vehicle.

Robots must be designed with a software mindset, but hardware must come first. Robots also need multiple speeds of thought, and the data they learn from needs variety, not merely volume.
https://www.economist.com/the-world-ahead/2026/11/18/get-ready-for-humanoid-robots-says-he-xiaopeng

topics.title_zh: OpenAI 修复计费漏洞，GPT-6.2 用户额度骤降 40%
topics.title_en: OpenAI Fixes Billing Glitch: GPT-6.2 Astra Quotas Cut by 40%
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI承认GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol模型在启动阶段存在定价错误，导致用户享受了长期的隐性折扣。漏洞修复后，用户达到使用上限的速度提升了25%至40%。此举引发了重度用户关于OpenAI定价不透明、模型价值锚定混乱的集体不满。
topics.summary_en: OpenAI acknowledged a pricing error at the launch of GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, which inadvertently provided users with excessive usage quotas. Post-patch, quotas are exhausted 25-40% faster, sparking significant backlash from power users regarding OpenAI's opaque pricing and inconsistent value proposition.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 修复定价错误是保证模型推理性价平衡的必要之举，只有通过精准定价，才能确保高额研发投入下的算力可持续性。
perspective_pro.point_en: Fixing pricing errors is essential to maintain the price-performance balance of model inference. Accurate pricing is the only way to ensure sustainability amidst massive R&D costs.

perspective_con.point_zh: 这种无需告知、单方面通过技术后台更改用户额度的操作，完全损害了消费者的忠诚度，缺乏对付费用户契约精神的尊重。
perspective_con.point_en: This unilateral change to usage quotas via backend tech, without proper communication, damages consumer loyalty and lacks respect for the contract with paid users.

linked_tweets.author: @addyosmani
linked_tweets.content_zh:
对于一名软件工程师来说，这是一个激动人心的时刻。是的，角色正在改变。但仍有许多有趣且雄心勃勃的问题有待解决。

“这是对于那些感到身份危机的工程师来说，因为他们认为自己的知识和技能并不重要——你和你的技能可能会决定这些问题能否得到解决，而多智能体系统是否可以解决世界上最困难的问题。你可以而且应该深入这些领域，学习新事物，并形成意见。这个问题的大部分空间都为新的解决方案敞开了大门。”
linked_tweets.content_en:
It's an exciting time to be a software engineer. Yes, the role is changing. But there remain so many interesting & ambitious problems yet to be solved.

"This is for the engineers feeling an identity crisis because they think their knowledge and skills won't be important - you and your skills can be the difference in whether or not these problems get tackled and multiagent systems can solve the world’s hardest problems. You can and should go deep in these domains, learn new things, and form opinions. So much of this problem space is wide open for new solutions."
